name: no-op rule
rule: Conservative: a text is a no-op only when EVERY sentence is a no-op phrase or a closed generic ask, with no other words, and at least one sentence is a no-op phrase. A wrong 'real' only lets an item through; a wrong 'no-op' hides a question from Jack.

Remove NO_OP_NOISE_RE matches (a leading 'Consult Jack:' and '(from t_x)' / '(from the card)'), split on SENTENCE_SPLIT_RE (. ; ! ? before a space or the end, and ' / '), collapse whitespace and strip spaces and commas at each end; drop empty sentences.

A no-op sentence is a full match of NO_OP_SENTENCE_RE: one or more NO_OP_RE phrases joined by 'and', ',' or ', and'. A generic ask is a full match of GENERIC_ASK_RE: 'what next', 'what should happen next', 'what should we do next', 'what do we do next', 'what now' or 'anything else'. Any other sentence (a label such as 'Prod: what now', a scope such as 'on staging', a URL, one extra word) is a real ask.
has_real_question means another question of the same item is real. Then a text whose NO_OP_RE matches all start with 'nothing else' is not a no-op either.
no_op_re: \bnothing (?:here |else )?(?:needs?|for) (?:jack|you)\b|\bnothing (?:to (?:fix|do|decide)|needs? (?:fixing|doing))\b|\bno (?:decision|action|input) (?:is )?(?:needed|required|for jack)\b|\bnot (?:a decision|an action item) for jack\b
no_op_sentence_re: (?:\bnothing (?:here |else )?(?:needs?|for) (?:jack|you)\b|\bnothing (?:to (?:fix|do|decide)|needs? (?:fixing|doing))\b|\bno (?:decision|action|input) (?:is )?(?:needed|required|for jack)\b|\bnot (?:a decision|an action item) for jack\b)(?:\s*(?:,\s*and|,|and)\s*(?:\bnothing (?:here |else )?(?:needs?|for) (?:jack|you)\b|\bnothing (?:to (?:fix|do|decide)|needs? (?:fixing|doing))\b|\bno (?:decision|action|input) (?:is )?(?:needed|required|for jack)\b|\bnot (?:a decision|an action item) for jack\b))*
generic_ask_re: what(?: should (?:happen|we do)| do we do)? next|what now|anything else
